notes.title: We actually made it! Patch is LIVE
notes.content:
That was close, we've made it on time!

All the work on Stay Close and Testing were just finalized minutes ago! That wouldn't be possible without the contribution of our new programmer who managed to finish all the tasks!

Stay Close is much more optimized now! Loads 2-3 times faster than before, as well as lot of minor bugs were eliminated. Previously stated in the announcement before there was a lot of changes, including new A.I and level design. 

The patch is a big deal, because provides us a really good foundation to build and implement more to the game without worrying the issues will stack. 

Hope you'll enjoy it! I can't wait to stalk new videos on YouTube and Twitch! 

Next patch will include new animations, sounds and maybe expanded level design. 

Great Summer, residents!

notes.title: Incoming patch - Next Week (End of June)
notes.content:
Hello residents,

The game will be patched very soon, including a lot of changes. 
~ Graphics improvements
~ New Monster A.I
~ Level Design Improvements/Changes
~ Secret Event
~ German Translation
~ Many minor fixes

Please note the patch could be unstable for a while due to the rapid changes. Please report any bugs and expect hotfixes! (we gonna try make it as stable till then).


Happy Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: Patchnotes for 1.05.5
notes.content:
[b]Misc:[/b]
- Added a connection status window when connecting to a game
- Fixed a bug where the client could get stuck on the loading screen if the connection fails
- Fixed a bug where the input gets broken when opening the ingame menu while a note is on screen
- Fixed the possibilty of messages getting stuck on screen ("It's not wise to go further", etc.)
- Fixed the field of view option, working now. (40 to 120, 80-90 recommended)
- Fixed the chat window is stuck on the screen if the player dies while chatting
- Changed the flashlight to turn off when starting a dialog with cyrus and when reading a note

notes.title: Patchnotes for 1.05.4.2
notes.content:
Misc: 
- Fix: Critical bug where a player could get a disconnect or get stuck after death

Map:
- Fix: Fool message at the end of the city was not visible

---------
We're sorry for the delay of this patch, took some time to recreate and fix the disconnect issue.
Please note that there could be some visual problems for the connected player at the first few seconds of the game, but they're gone as soon as the game is starting.
With the critical bug fixed, we are working on patches to fix the smaller bugs - releasing in the upcoming days!
If you experience any bugs, feel free to report them in our forum. Thank you!

notes.title: Patchnotes 1.05
notes.content:
[b]Misc:[/b]
- Improved the save game function, so it's saving after the dialog progress, too.
- Add: Game settings to disable the headbob
- Fix: Attempt to fix the "timeout" some players experience while loading a coop game
- Fix: Attempt to fix the "steam voice enabled" some players experience
- Fix: Attempt to support higher screen resolutions
- Reduced post process bloom
- Reduced post process Lens Flares
- Adjusted the blocking volumes of white fog
- Adjusted the mouse movement settings scale

[b]Players:[/b]
- Adjusted player movement & sprinting
- Adjusted player flashlight
- Adjusted headbob

[b]AIs:[/b]
- Adjusted some AI stats
- Improved the Creeper AI
- Add: Various possible spawnpositions for each AI
- Remade all AI spawns
- Add: Activated creeping / moving AIs around the town
- Fix: AI Pathfinding getting stuck

[b]Dialogs:[/b]
- Add: Indicator if the given answer is wrong
- Add: Name of the actor who's talking is visible now

[b]World:[/b]
- Fix: Brigde in the park could get the player stuck
- Optimized the world, should improve loading time and performance
- Fix: flickering light at cyrus
- Fix: Made the lake inaccessible
